description: Reads the state of the explainer clip of one webinar: queued, running, succeeded or failed, and once it is finished the link to the MP4. The link works for 24 hours; asking again returns a fresh one, so never store it as permanent. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it after starting a clip (that is wi_create_explainer_video) and never claim a finished clip before this answer says succeeded and carries a link. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

task_id.description: The task from the start call. Leave it out to read the webinar's last clip.

name: wi_get_explainer_video
title: Read the state of the explainer clip
